## Built into serened

SereneDB and the libraries below are built into serened. `SELECT * FROM sdb_licenses` lists the ones a server was built with, with the text of each license file.

## Fonts

Used only to generate the logo SVGs in `resources/images/`, not shipped in the
distribution. The generated SVGs carry outline paths, so the font is not needed
to display them.

* [DM Sans](https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts) -- [SIL Open Font License 1.1](../resources/fonts/OFL.txt)

## Tests

Libraries used only by the test suite, not shipped in the distribution.

* [Google Test](https://github.com/google/googletest), BSD-3-Clause
* [Google Benchmark](https://github.com/google/benchmark), Apache-2.0
* [cmocka](https://cmocka.org), Apache-2.0
* [sqllogictest-rs](https://github.com/risinglightdb/sqllogictest-rs)
* [sqlite sqllogictest](https://github.com/serenedb/sqllogictest), its `COPYRIGHT.md`
